population: One selected Nanobot attempt per task from the 59 ZIPs. Read and batch counts use native, non-synthetic events.
method: Pair starts with tool.finished or tool.failed by agent and call ID. Within each nanobot_tool_batch, count pairs whose monotonic intervals have a strictly positive intersection. Check every batch against its native branch.joined counters. Explicit line reads supply offset or limit in the original read_file call. Version is from actual-client-request snapshots only.
